an6.143-169:1.1: rāgassa bhikkhave pariññāya [cha dhammā bhāvetabbā …pe… rāgassa bhikkhave] parikkhayāya …pe… pahānāya …pe… khayāya …pe… vayāya …pe… virāgāya …pe… nirodhāya …pe… cāgāya …pe… paṭinissaggāya ime cha dhammā bhāvetabbā’ti. 31-60 dosassa [bhikkhave abhiññāya cha dhammā bhāvetabbā …pe… dosassa bhikkhave] pariññāya …pe…
